schedulingEngine.semesterSplit: Automatic per-rule semester splitting, with FORBID_LESSON override
schedulingEngine.spillover: Unplaced lessons cascade between semesters for fractional rules
schedulingEngine.attempts: Generates N candidate schedules, scores each, keeps best
schedulingEngine.scoring: Placement completeness dominates; teacher distribution compactness + load deviation as tiebreakers; pinned FORBID_LESSON rules penalized 500x
schedulingEngine.rearrange: suggestRearrange in src/worker/rearrange.ts resolves drops: (1) direct move when target free, (2) eligible-teacher swap when the original teacher is busy, (3) relocate blocking lessons to free slots. Hard-infeasible: same-group occupancy, NO_FIRST_PERIOD, group/rule daily caps; split/double partners cannot be displaced by a single-lesson move.
schedulingEngine.progress: Generator emits PROGRESS per attempt (attempt, attempts, bestQuality, pct = attempt/attempts*95) and a final 100; App shows a progress bar + percent in the header while generating.
schedulingEngine.autoMaxPerDay: Derived from the load distribution: >5 weekly hours -> 2 lessons/day, <=5 -> 1/day, doubleLesson keeps a pair (2/day). Explicit MAX_DAILY_LESSONS constraints override. Applied in generator and edit-mode analyzer; shown in ConstraintEditor.

completedTasks.title: Deep 15-swap rearrange cascade + force-insert fallback in edit mode
completedTasks.body: Removed the hard block on drag-drop inserts in edit mode. Drop resolution now asks the engine for a deep rearrangement first: resolvePlacement gained maxDepth (edit-mode suggestRearrange/suggestRearrangeChoices pass 15, generation-time resolveUnplacedPlacement stays 1) and a recursive relocate() displaces colliding teacher/room occupants toward a hole, bounded by a 12000-node budget (searchNodes). A per-suggestion 'claimed' slot set reserves the main target and prevents two displaced lessons landing in the same destination slot (fixes the realProject.test.ts invariant violation). When no rearrangement can open the slot, InlineEditor force-inserts the lesson directly via commitFromMoves with feasible:true and no modal; the grid analyzer flags resulting conflicts. Removed the rearrange_block* modal and 9 i18n keys (en/uk). Split/double-partner lessons stay unmovable in the cascade. Tests: new rearrange.test.ts cascade fixture (9 groups, busy teacher, displaced chain -> hole) and two InlineEditor blocked->force-insert cases. Full suite 197 tests / 18 files green; tsc + npm run build green.

completedTasks.title: Worker-side AI rearrangement with edit-mode confirm + fluent progress UI
completedTasks.body: New pure suggestRearrange engine (src/worker/rearrange.ts) resolves edit-mode drops: direct move when the target slot is free, otherwise search for an eligible substitute teacher, otherwise relocate blocking lessons to free slots. Hard-infeasible when the same group already occupies a slot, when NO_FIRST_PERIOD blocks it, or when group/rule daily caps would be exceeded; split/double-partner lessons cannot be displaced. Added REARRANGE / REARRANGE_RESULT worker messages and types (RearrangeMove, RearrangeSuggestion, ProgressPayload). Generator now emits per-attempt PROGRESS payloads (attempt, attempts, bestQuality, pct of a 95-point window) plus a final 100. InlineEditor routes drag-drop through the engine: free-slot drops commit instantly, multi-move/teacher-swap drops open a confirmation modal listing each move (with a reassign badge), infeasible drops show a blocked notice. App header renders a progress bar + percent while generating and a 'best of N' status after. GenerateModal exposes optimizePasses (0-60, default 8). New en i18n keys and CSS. Tests: src/test/worker/rearrange.test.ts (10 engine cases), GenerateModal spinbutton index updates, InlineEditor pool placement/blocked/confirm flows. Full suite 187 tests / 18 files green; npm run build green.

completedTasks.title: Automatic MAX_LESSON_PER_DAY (MAX_DAILY_LESSONS) from load distribution
completedTasks.body: Changed the per-subject daily lesson limit logic: the effective MAX_DAILY_LESSONS is now derived automatically from the load distribution (a lesson is limited to 2 per day when its weekly load exceeds 5 hours, otherwise 1 per day; doubleLesson rules keep their pair allowance). Explicit MAX_DAILY_LESSONS constraints override the automatic value. autoMaxPerDay() + buildMaxDailyByRule() added in src/shared/types.ts and reused by the generator (src/worker/generator.ts), the edit-mode analyzer (src/ui/services/scheduleAnalyzer.ts), and shown read-only in ConstraintEditor with new i18n keys (auto_daily_limits, auto_daily_limits_desc, auto_limit_overridden). Tests: src/test/shared/dailyLimit.test.ts, src/test/worker/autoDailyLimit.test.ts, +4 analyzer cases. Full suite 175 tests / 17 files green; npm run build green.
